name: ar-v2
description: Eyewear AR try-on: scan once, track against the scan, seat by contact physics.

scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/check-isolation.mjs && node scripts/check-constants.mjs && node scripts/check-selfcontained.mjs && node scripts/check-reports.mjs && node --test "dist/tests/**/*.test.js"
scripts.report:enroll: npm run build && node scripts/check-reports.mjs --write enroll
scripts.report:seat: npm run build && node scripts/check-reports.mjs --write seat
scripts.report:track: npm run build && node scripts/check-reports.mjs --write track
scripts.report:occlusion: npm run build && node scripts/check-reports.mjs --write occlusion
